connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU request in vCPU. The limit is twice the request.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory request in GiB. The limit is twice the request.

db.title: Metadata database
db.description: Connection to the SQL database hosting the metastore schema. Its credentials Secret holds the keys username and password.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store hosting the warehouse.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this consumer's own S3 identity.

warehouseBucket.title: Warehouse bucket
warehouseBucket.description: S3 bucket used as the warehouse directory.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

hive-metastore.title: hive-metastore
hive-metastore.description: Values of the hive-metastore chart 1.4.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/hive-metastore), for example image, replicaCount, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, configOverrides, networkPolicies, s3.proxy. Refused: fullNameOverride, serviceName, servicePort, db, s3.url, s3.accessKey, s3.secretKey, cloud_storage, initJob.annotations. Appended to the list this chart sets: extraEnvRaw.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
